summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the transmission-line-hardware node finds one unusually direct underfollowed public candidate, PLPC, plus larger reference or adjacent names. The strongest direct-node mapping is Preformed Line Products, which sells line hardware and reported rising backlog. Hubbell is the larger reference product leader in utility T&D components. MYR Group is a smaller downstream transmission contractor whose project activity can be used as a demand signal for upstream hardware procurement. Valmont is an adjacent infrastructure supplier through transmission structures, not line hardware itself, so it is included as a second-order asset/hardware-adjacent comp rather than a pure node match. Expanded the transmission-line-hardware node into a compact two-lane universe. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is PLPC, a niche public supplier of hardware used in overhead energy and communications networks with reported backlog growth. HUBB is a larger reference/component leader with broad transmission connectors, insulators, arresters, and line-hardware exposure. VMI is an adjacent structures and utility infrastructure supplier that may benefit if transmission buildout shifts bottlenecks from EPC labor to fabricated support structures. MYRG is not a hardware supplier, but is included as a smaller EPC/customer-context anchor for validating whether transmission work is accelerating into the procurement layer. Claims linking these companies specifically to AI/data-center load growth remain mostly inference or hypothesis unless supported by future order, backlog, utility
